main.title: "제발 더 만들어줘" 젠슨 황의 간청…SK하이닉스·삼성전자, HBM 공급 '속도'
main.body: 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO) 젠슨 황이 SK하이닉스와 삼성전자에 HBM 생산 속도를 높여달라는 강한 메시지를 전달한 것으로 알려졌다. 5일 업계에 따르면 황 CEO는 지난 2일 대만 컴퓨텍스 2026 행사에서 SK하이닉스 부스를 방문해 HBM4E(7세대) 웨이퍼 샘플에 'Please make more'라고 직접 사인을 남겼다. 또 SoCAMM2 제품에는 'LOVE SOCAMM'이라는 문구도 적었다. 황 CEO는 최태원 SK그룹 회장과 SK하이닉스 경영진과 기념촬영도 진행했다. 황 CEO는 HBM 공급에 대해 '성능, 품질, 신뢰성, 공급 능력이 모두 중요하다'며 '기술이 겉보기엔 단순해 보여도 굉장히 복잡하다'고 강조했다. SK하이닉스 최태원 회장은 5년 내 웨이퍼 생산 능력을 두 배로 늘리겠다고 약속하면서, 메모리 병목 현상이 2030년까지 지속될 것이라는 전망을 유지했다. 삼성전자는 컴퓨텍스에서 차세대 HBM5(8세대)의 시제품을 처음으로 공개했다. HBM5는 열 경로 블록 기술과 2나노 베이스 다이 아키텍처를 적용한 제품으로, 기존 HBM4 대비 획기적인 성능 향상이 기대된다. 삼성전자는 AMD의 차세대 AI 가속기용 주요 HBM 공급사로도 지명된 바 있다. 한편 엔비디아 베라 루빈 플랫폼에는 삼성전자, SK하이닉스, 마이크론이 모두 HBM4 공급사로 참여 중이며, 2026년 전체 HBM 생산량이 이미 완판된 상태다.

main.select_reason: HBM4E/HBM5 신규 디스클로저 + AMD 차세대 가속기 공급사 지명 + 2026 HBM 완판 — MangoBoost가 가장 관심 가질 HBM/AMD 생태계 흐름이 한 기사에 응축. 헤드라인 3요건(MangoBoost 코어 영향, 자체 뉴스성, substantive 신규 정보)을 모두 충족.

main.title: Kospi Index Slumps Over 6% at One Point, Samsung Electronics Falls Over 7%, SK Hynix Drops More Than 9%, AI Bubble Fears Partially Erupt
main.body: South Korea's stock market experienced a sharp selloff on June 5, 2026, with the KOSPI index dropping over 6% during Asian trading. The Korea Exchange activated its circuit breaker mechanism after KOSPI 200 futures fell 5%, halting program trading for five minutes. Samsung Electronics tumbled more than 7%, while SK Hynix plunged over 9%. The previous day had already seen weakness, with the KOSPI declining 1.84%. The primary trigger stemmed from Broadcom's earnings report on June 3. The chipmaker guided for Q3 AI chip sales of $16 billion — below market expectations of $17.2 billion. Full-year AI revenue guidance of $56 billion also fell short of the projected $57.6 billion. Broadcom shares dropped over 15% in after-hours trading, which subsequently dragged the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 5.45%. South Korea's Finance Minister expressed concerns about leveraged investments and 'herd mentality' in financial markets that day. The KOSPI, heavily weighted toward semiconductors, has seen substantial foreign investor net sales totaling approximately $22 billion since May, with SK Hynix recording roughly $12 billion in monthly outflows. The selloff reflects unwinding of crowded positions as confidence in the AI narrative softens globally. Analysts noted that the decline represented profit-taking rather than fundamental deterioration. Kiwoom Securities analyst Han Ji-young stated: 'Recent adjustments are consolidation after rapid gains, not fundamental problems.' The KOSPI had previously reached record highs above 8,600 points just days before, driven by Jensen Huang's Korea Partner Night in Taipei and the announcement of the Vera Rubin production ramp. Published June 5, 2026 at 12:28 AM KST by TradingKey.
main.keep_reason: Broadcom Q3 AI 칩 가이던스 미스($16B vs $17.2B 기대)로 KOSPI 회로차단기 발동, 외국인 $22B 순매도 — AI 사이클 신호 (market).
main.select_reason: 한국 시장사적 사건(회로차단기 발동) + Broadcom guidance 정량 데이터 + 외인 $22B 순매도 + AI 사이클 톤 변화 — 월요일 미팅에서 가장 먼저 거론될 매크로 신호. id=3과 카테고리·각도 모두 독립적이라 헤드라인 두 슬롯의 분산 요건 충족.

main.title: 젠슨 황 오늘 최태원·정의선·구광모·이해진과 '삼소회동'
main.body: 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO) 젠슨 황이 7개월 만에 한국을 다시 찾아 국내 주요 기업 총수들과 서울의 명소에서 만찬 회동을 갖는다. 5일 업계에 따르면 황 CEO는 이날 오후 전세기편으로 서울 강서구 서울김포비즈니스항공센터(SGBAC)를 통해 입국할 예정이다. 이후 저녁에는 최태원 SK그룹 회장, 정의선 현대차그룹 회장, 구광모 LG그룹 회장, 이해진 네이버 의장 등 국내 AI 반도체 및 피지컬 AI 산업을 대표하는 기업 총수들과 서울 홍대 인근 한국식 BBQ 식당에서 만찬을 진행한다. 이번 회동은 지난해 10월 강남 치킨집에서 '깐부회동'이라는 별명으로 불렸던 만남 이후 7개월 만이다. 이번 만찬은 삼겹살과 소주를 뜻하는 '삼소회동'으로 불리고 있다. 황 CEO는 오는 8일까지 나흘에 걸쳐 SK그룹, 현대자동차그룹, LG그룹 등 국내 주요 대기업 총수를 비롯해 AI·로봇 스타트업 관계자들을 잇달아 만나며 촘촘한 일정을 소화할 예정이다. 두산 베어스는 오는 7일 열리는 키움 히어로즈와 정규시즌 홈 경기에서 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO가 시구를, 박정원 두산 회장이 시타를 각각 한다고 밝혔다. 황 CEO는 이번 방한 기간 동안 서울대학교도 방문할 예정으로, 국내 AI 생태계 구축과 피지컬 AI 협력 방안을 중점적으로 논의할 계획이다. 이번 회동에서는 HBM을 비롯한 AI 메모리, AI 데이터센터, 자율주행, 로보틱스, 피지컬 AI 등 다양한 분야의 협력이 논의될 것으로 전망된다.

main.title: Chip Capacity Constraints Put A Governor On AI Spending Growth
main.body: According to Gartner's latest projections, AI infrastructure spending forecasts were increased by only 4.8 points for 2026 and 8.1 points for 2027 — modest adjustments attributed largely to 'opportunistic pricing more than capacity expansion.' The author argues that memory supply constraints are moderating AI spending forecasts. AI spending's share of total IT budgets has surged dramatically. As the author notes, 'AI went from accounting for 13.7 percent of total IT spending in 2024 to 31.7 percent of the IT pie in 2025.' Significantly, the broader IT budget actually contracted by 12.6 percent during this period, indicating funds were redirected toward AI initiatives. The world's hyperscalers — Microsoft, Amazon, Google, and Meta — have collectively committed upwards of $725 billion in capital expenditures in 2026, with 75% targeted at AI infrastructure. Yet despite this unprecedented investment, Gartner's adjustments remain modest because the bottlenecks are physical: manufacturing capacity, CoWoS advanced packaging throughput, HBM availability, and specialized engineering talent cannot scale as quickly as financial commitments. The author, Timothy Prickett Morgan, concludes that the governor on AI spending growth is ultimately not financial appetite — which remains nearly unlimited — but silicon supply and the pace of new fabrication capacity coming online. HBM manufacturers SK Hynix, Samsung, and Micron have all preallocated 2026 production, and TSMC's CoWoS advanced packaging capacity remains oversubscribed through at least 2027. By 2027, aggregate AI spending could exceed non-AI IT spending for the first time historically. However, this trajectory depends on demonstrable returns: companies must prove investments generate productivity gains, cost reductions, and revenue increases. A recession or failure to deliver measurable AI benefits could dramatically alter spending patterns.
main.keep_reason: Gartner $725B capex/2026 75% AI 인프라 + CoWoS/HBM 제약 2027까지 — AI 인프라 공급 병목 (challenges).
main.select_reason: Next Platform의 strategic framing — Gartner 정량(IT 예산의 31.7% → AI, $725B 하이퍼스케일러 capex)과 CoWoS/HBM 병목 narrative를 한 기사로 응축. id=14의 시장 신호를 산업 구조로 설명하는 보완 각도.

main.title: Marvell Unveils 'Teralynx T100' Ultra-High-Speed AI Switch Chip
main.body: Marvell Technology announced the Teralynx T100, a data center switch semiconductor delivering 102.4-terabits-per-second (Tbps) throughput. The 3-nanometer chip targets artificial intelligence infrastructure. The company claims the T100 reduces power consumption by approximately 25% compared to competing solutions while maintaining 'among the lowest latency levels in its bandwidth class.' The chip supports up to 512 ports, enabling connection of multiple servers and GPU accelerators through a single system. By supporting more ports per device, the architecture reduces required networking layers and data path hops. This approach lowers total cost of ownership through decreased power usage and simplified infrastructure deployment. Marvell plans to distribute samples to key customers during the current quarter, with performance demonstrations during customer evaluation phases. The T100 comes in multiple package configurations, including ball grid array (BGA), co-packaged copper (CPC) and co-packaged optics (CPO) implementations. The chip competes against Broadcom's Tomahawk 6, which began volume production in March 2026. Marvell CEO Matt Murphy had previously described connectivity as 'the next AI bottleneck,' and NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang proclaimed Marvell 'the next trillion dollar company' at Computex 2026, sending Marvell shares up 33%. The T100 is manufactured on a 3nm process, enabling ultra-low latency for AI training and inference workloads at datacenter scale. This The Elec English coverage article was published June 5, 2026 at 07:30 KST.

main.select_reason: Marvell의 직접 경쟁사인 Broadcom Tomahawk 6를 겨냥한 3nm 102.4Tbps 스위치 + CPO/CPC 패키징 — MangoBoost DPU/SmartNIC 가치사슬 인접 product 업데이트로 직원 주목도 높음.

main.title: DDR5 RAM Hits $375 Floor for PC Builders: HBM Takes Three Times More Wafers
main.body: The cheapest available 32GB DDR5 kit is now priced at $374.97, with no comparable option available below that level. A component that cost less than $100 a year ago now costs nearly four times as much. The pricing surge is driven by structural shifts in semiconductor manufacturing. Micron noted a 3-to-1 conversion ratio between HBM and DDR5 wafer capacity, meaning every HBM ramp directly compresses general-purpose memory supply. An HBM module sells for roughly $60 to $100, compared to $5 to $10 for a comparable amount of conventional DDR5 DRAM. When production capacity is constrained and one product category generates margins five to ten times higher than another, rational manufacturers will always prioritize the higher-margin product. Samsung and SK Hynix warn the shortage runs through at least 2027. Conventional DRAM contract prices will rise 58% to 63% quarter-over-quarter in Q2 2026, while NAND Flash contract prices will jump 70% to 75% QoQ. New fabrication capacity is under construction but will not deliver meaningful relief within the current shortage window. Samsung's P5 megafab in Pyeongtaek, South Korea, targets mass production in the latter part of 2028. SK Hynix's M15X facility is slated for utilization by mid-2027. Micron projects first wafer output from its Boise, Idaho fab in mid-2027. AI data centers are projected to consume 70% of all memory chips produced by 2026, directly competing with and deprioritizing automotive and consumer electronics orders.
main.keep_reason: HBM:DDR5 웨이퍼 3:1 변환, 데이터센터 2026년 메모리 70% 소비, DRAM 가격 +58~63% QoQ — DPU 시스템 메모리 수급 직격 (challenges).
main.select_reason: HBM:DDR5 3:1 웨이퍼 변환, DRAM +58~63% QoQ, NAND +70~75% QoQ, P5/M15X/Boise 팹 타임라인까지 정량 농도 매우 높음 — DPU 시스템 메모리 BOM에 직격되는 challenges. id=1의 capex 매크로와 각도 분리.

main.title: [금융·헬스케어 강세에 다우지수 875포인트 급등...마이크론 7.74% 급락]
main.body: 6월 4일(현지시간) 뉴욕 증시에서 다우존스 산업평균지수가 874.86포인트(1.73%) 오른 51,561.93을 기록하며 사상 최고치를 경신했다. S&P500은 30.63포인트(0.41%) 오른 7,584.31, 나스닥은 23.02포인트(0.09%) 내린 26,830.96으로 마감했다. 금융·헬스케어 섹터의 강세가 다우 상승을 이끌었다. 반면 메모리 반도체 기업 마이크론 테크놀로지는 7.74% 급락해 기술주 전반에 그림자를 드리웠다. 이는 브로드컴의 AI 칩 가이던스 실망에 반도체 섹터 전반이 약세를 보인 영향이다. 브로드컴은 3분기 AI 칩 매출 전망으로 160억달러를 제시했는데, 이는 월가 예상(172억달러)을 밑도는 것으로 주가가 15% 이상 급락했다. 혼조세 장세는 기술주에서 금융·헬스케어로의 자금 이동(섹터 로테이션)을 반영한다. 최근 두 달간 반도체주의 급등 이후 차익 실현 매물이 출회되고 있는 것으로 분석됐다.
main.keep_reason: Micron 7.74% 급락, Broadcom -15%, 필라델피아 반도체지수 -5.45% — 미국 측 반도체 섹터 로테이션 신호 (market).
main.select_reason: id=14의 KOSPI 충격의 미국측 거울 — Dow 사상최고 vs Micron -7.74%/Broadcom -15%의 섹터 로테이션 디테일로 별도 각도 제공. Broadcom 경쟁사 태깅 기사라 competitor 섹션에도 자연스럽게 진입.

main.title: GlobalFoundries acquires Synopsys ARC processor IP business
main.body: GlobalFoundries has finalized its acquisition of Synopsys' ARC Processor IP Solutions business, integrating it into its MIPS subsidiary. The deal, initially announced in January 2026, combines several critical components: the ARC processor product lines (ARC-V, ARC Classic, ARC VPX DSP), engineering and design personnel, ASIP Designer tools for processor customization, and ASIP Programmer software development tools. The combined platform now encompasses 'RISC-V intellectual property, software tools, custom design capabilities and advanced manufacturing processes aimed at physical artificial intelligence platforms,' according to the article. MIPS CEO Sameer Wasson emphasized that the merger will enable development of 'differentiated application-specific solutions for automotive, robotics and embedded systems markets.' The integration aims to streamline collaboration between customers and the company, potentially shortening product development timelines by enabling earlier-stage architectural involvement through mass production phases. The acquisition positions GlobalFoundries with a software-to-silicon capability purpose built for physical AI, spanning from architecture selection through manufacturing. This is particularly significant for embedded AI applications in edge devices, industrial robotics, and automotive systems — markets where GlobalFoundries has strong existing manufacturing relationships. The deal closed on June 2, 2026, according to a Malta, NY press release dated that day. The The Elec article covering the completed acquisition was published June 5, 2026.
main.keep_reason: GF가 MIPS 산하로 ARC/RISC-V IP 통합, 피지컬 AI/embedded AI 타겟 — 파운드리·IP 생태계 재편 (products).
main.select_reason: GF MIPS 산하 ARC/RISC-V IP 통합 — 피지컬 AI/embedded/automotive 타겟의 IP+파운드리 수직통합. 다른 메인이 모두 메모리/AI 인프라/시장 쪽이라 IP/파운드리 각도로 카테고리·테마 다양성 보강.

competitor_articles.title: Kospi Index Slumps Over 6% at One Point, Samsung Electronics Falls Over 7%, SK Hynix Drops More Than 9%, AI Bubble Fears Partially Erupt
competitor_articles.body: South Korea's stock market experienced a sharp selloff on June 5, 2026, with the KOSPI index dropping over 6% during Asian trading. The Korea Exchange activated its circuit breaker mechanism after KOSPI 200 futures fell 5%, halting program trading for five minutes. Samsung Electronics tumbled more than 7%, while SK Hynix plunged over 9%. The previous day had already seen weakness, with the KOSPI declining 1.84%. The primary trigger stemmed from Broadcom's earnings report on June 3. The chipmaker guided for Q3 AI chip sales of $16 billion — below market expectations of $17.2 billion. Full-year AI revenue guidance of $56 billion also fell short of the projected $57.6 billion. Broadcom shares dropped over 15% in after-hours trading, which subsequently dragged the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 5.45%. South Korea's Finance Minister expressed concerns about leveraged investments and 'herd mentality' in financial markets that day. The KOSPI, heavily weighted toward semiconductors, has seen substantial foreign investor net sales totaling approximately $22 billion since May, with SK Hynix recording roughly $12 billion in monthly outflows. The selloff reflects unwinding of crowded positions as confidence in the AI narrative softens globally. Analysts noted that the decline represented profit-taking rather than fundamental deterioration. Kiwoom Securities analyst Han Ji-young stated: 'Recent adjustments are consolidation after rapid gains, not fundamental problems.' The KOSPI had previously reached record highs above 8,600 points just days before, driven by Jensen Huang's Korea Partner Night in Taipei and the announcement of the Vera Rubin production ramp. Published June 5, 2026 at 12:28 AM KST by TradingKey.

competitor_articles.title: Marvell Unveils 'Teralynx T100' Ultra-High-Speed AI Switch Chip
competitor_articles.body: Marvell Technology announced the Teralynx T100, a data center switch semiconductor delivering 102.4-terabits-per-second (Tbps) throughput. The 3-nanometer chip targets artificial intelligence infrastructure. The company claims the T100 reduces power consumption by approximately 25% compared to competing solutions while maintaining 'among the lowest latency levels in its bandwidth class.' The chip supports up to 512 ports, enabling connection of multiple servers and GPU accelerators through a single system. By supporting more ports per device, the architecture reduces required networking layers and data path hops. This approach lowers total cost of ownership through decreased power usage and simplified infrastructure deployment. Marvell plans to distribute samples to key customers during the current quarter, with performance demonstrations during customer evaluation phases. The T100 comes in multiple package configurations, including ball grid array (BGA), co-packaged copper (CPC) and co-packaged optics (CPO) implementations. The chip competes against Broadcom's Tomahawk 6, which began volume production in March 2026. Marvell CEO Matt Murphy had previously described connectivity as 'the next AI bottleneck,' and NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang proclaimed Marvell 'the next trillion dollar company' at Computex 2026, sending Marvell shares up 33%. The T100 is manufactured on a 3nm process, enabling ultra-low latency for AI training and inference workloads at datacenter scale. This The Elec English coverage article was published June 5, 2026 at 07:30 KST.

competitor_articles.title: 젠슨 황 오늘 최태원·정의선·구광모·이해진과 '삼소회동'
competitor_articles.body: 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO) 젠슨 황이 7개월 만에 한국을 다시 찾아 국내 주요 기업 총수들과 서울의 명소에서 만찬 회동을 갖는다. 5일 업계에 따르면 황 CEO는 이날 오후 전세기편으로 서울 강서구 서울김포비즈니스항공센터(SGBAC)를 통해 입국할 예정이다. 이후 저녁에는 최태원 SK그룹 회장, 정의선 현대차그룹 회장, 구광모 LG그룹 회장, 이해진 네이버 의장 등 국내 AI 반도체 및 피지컬 AI 산업을 대표하는 기업 총수들과 서울 홍대 인근 한국식 BBQ 식당에서 만찬을 진행한다. 이번 회동은 지난해 10월 강남 치킨집에서 '깐부회동'이라는 별명으로 불렸던 만남 이후 7개월 만이다. 이번 만찬은 삼겹살과 소주를 뜻하는 '삼소회동'으로 불리고 있다. 황 CEO는 오는 8일까지 나흘에 걸쳐 SK그룹, 현대자동차그룹, LG그룹 등 국내 주요 대기업 총수를 비롯해 AI·로봇 스타트업 관계자들을 잇달아 만나며 촘촘한 일정을 소화할 예정이다. 두산 베어스는 오는 7일 열리는 키움 히어로즈와 정규시즌 홈 경기에서 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO가 시구를, 박정원 두산 회장이 시타를 각각 한다고 밝혔다. 황 CEO는 이번 방한 기간 동안 서울대학교도 방문할 예정으로, 국내 AI 생태계 구축과 피지컬 AI 협력 방안을 중점적으로 논의할 계획이다. 이번 회동에서는 HBM을 비롯한 AI 메모리, AI 데이터센터, 자율주행, 로보틱스, 피지컬 AI 등 다양한 분야의 협력이 논의될 것으로 전망된다.

competitor_articles.title: Jensen Huang to Meet South Korea's Business Leaders in Seoul for AI Alliance Talks
competitor_articles.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang arrived in Seoul on June 5, 2026, for a four-day visit to meet with the heads of South Korea's major conglomerates to discuss artificial intelligence partnerships. Huang arrived at Seoul's Gimpo Business Aviation Center via a chartered flight and was expected to begin meetings with leading Korean business figures that evening. The gathering brought together SK Group Chairman Tae-won Choi, Hyundai Motor Group Chairman Euisun Chung, LG Group Chairman Kwang-mo Koo, and Naver Chairman Lee Hae-jin for a dinner reportedly held at a Korean barbecue restaurant in the Hongdae district of Seoul — earning the nickname 'samso meeting' (pork belly and soju). This represented Huang's return to Korea seven months after his previous high-profile visit during the APEC Summit in Gyeongju, where he met with Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong and Hyundai Motor Group Chairman Chung. During his four-day stay through June 8, discussions were expected to span HBM chip supplies, AI data centers, physical AI platforms including Nvidia's Omniverse and Isaac robotics frameworks, and autonomous driving technology where these Korean conglomerates maintain existing partnerships. Future technology partnerships in AI chips, physical AI and data centers are the primary agenda, according to Korea Economic Daily. The visit follows Nvidia's announcement of its Vera Rubin GPU platform entering full production, with Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron confirmed as HBM4 memory suppliers.

competitor_articles.title: [금융·헬스케어 강세에 다우지수 875포인트 급등...마이크론 7.74% 급락]
competitor_articles.body: 6월 4일(현지시간) 뉴욕 증시에서 다우존스 산업평균지수가 874.86포인트(1.73%) 오른 51,561.93을 기록하며 사상 최고치를 경신했다. S&P500은 30.63포인트(0.41%) 오른 7,584.31, 나스닥은 23.02포인트(0.09%) 내린 26,830.96으로 마감했다. 금융·헬스케어 섹터의 강세가 다우 상승을 이끌었다. 반면 메모리 반도체 기업 마이크론 테크놀로지는 7.74% 급락해 기술주 전반에 그림자를 드리웠다. 이는 브로드컴의 AI 칩 가이던스 실망에 반도체 섹터 전반이 약세를 보인 영향이다. 브로드컴은 3분기 AI 칩 매출 전망으로 160억달러를 제시했는데, 이는 월가 예상(172억달러)을 밑도는 것으로 주가가 15% 이상 급락했다. 혼조세 장세는 기술주에서 금융·헬스케어로의 자금 이동(섹터 로테이션)을 반영한다. 최근 두 달간 반도체주의 급등 이후 차익 실현 매물이 출회되고 있는 것으로 분석됐다.

competitor_articles.title: Doosan Chairman Park Jeongwon to Meet Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at Jamsil Baseball Stadium
competitor_articles.body: Doosan Group Chairman Park Jeongwon, who owns the Doosan Bears baseball team, will participate in a pregame ceremony with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on June 7 at Jamsil Baseball Stadium in Seoul. The ceremony features a creative display of corporate history: Huang will pitch wearing jersey number 93, representing Nvidia's founding year, while Park will bat wearing number 96, representing Doosan's founding year. The event is part of Huang's four-day visit to South Korea running from June 5 to June 8. Industry observers interpret this event as expanding the companies' existing business relationship into direct executive engagement. The article suggests separate business meetings between the two sides may also occur during Huang's visit. Huang's Korea schedule includes a dinner with SK Group Chairman Choi Tae-won, Hyundai Motor Chairman Chung Euisun, LG Group Chairman Koo Kwang-mo, and Naver Chairman Lee Hae-jin on the evening of June 5. The baseball appearance adds a symbolic cultural dimension to the AI chip partnership negotiations that form the core business of the visit.
